extracted.name: Soup maker tomato soup
extracted.description: Make this tasty tomato soup in a soup maker for delicious results with minimal effort. It's low in calories and fat, and delivers two of your 5-a-day
ingredient_lines: 500g ripe tomatoes off the vine and quartered or halved
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients into the soup maker and press the ‘smooth soup’ function. Make sure you don’t fill the soup maker above the max fill line.
Once the cycle is complete, season well, and check the soup for sweetness. Add a little more sugar, salt or tomato puree for depth of colour, if you like.
